# opusdns_tag (Data Source)

Reads a single tag by id (`GET /v1/tags/{tag_id}`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a single tag by id.
data "opusdns_tag" "production" {
  tag_id = "tag_01jxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
}

output "production_label" {
  value = data.opusdns_tag.production.label
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag_id` (String) The tag id (e.g. `tag_01j...`).

### Read-Only

- `color` (String)
- `created_on` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `id` (String) Mirrors `tag_id`.
- `label` (String)
- `object_count` (Number)
- `type` (String) One of `DOMAIN`, `CONTACT`, `ZONE`.
- `updated_on` (String)
